package aiprompt

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	templateCode         = "course.lesson-content.v1"
	maximumResponseBytes = 1 << 20
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

func (client Client) GenerateLesson(
	ctx context.Context,
	input domainservice.LessonGenerationInput,
	idempotencyKey string,
) (domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" ||
		client.HTTPClient == nil || input.CourseContext == nil || strings.TrimSpace(input.Language) == "" {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, errors.New("ai prompt client is not configured")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"idempotency_key": idempotencyKey,
		"template_code":   templateCode,
		"language_code":   input.Language,
		"variables": map[string]any{
			"course_context": input.CourseContext,
			"lesson_plan":    input.Lesson,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, err
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential"
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, requestURL, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	response, err := client.HTTPClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, err
	}
	if len(contents) > maximumResponseBytes {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, errors.New("ai prompt response exceeds limit")
	}
	if response.StatusCode < 200 || response.StatusCode >= 300 {
		switch response.StatusCode {
		case http.StatusConflict:
			return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, domain.ErrConflict
		case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
			return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, domain.ErrValidation
		default:
			return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, fmt.Errorf("ai prompt returned status %d", response.StatusCode)
		}
	}
	var envelope struct {
		ExecutionID        string          `json:"execution_id"`
		IdempotencyKey     string          `json:"idempotency_key"`
		TemplateCode       string          `json:"template_code"`
		TemplateVersion    int             `json:"template_version"`
		ProviderCode       string          `json:"provider_code"`
		ProviderModel      string          `json:"provider_model"`
		LanguageCode       string          `json:"language_code"`
		ResponseSchemaCode string          `json:"response_schema_code"`
		ParsedResponse     json.RawMessage `json:"parsed_response"`
		Cached             bool            `json:"cached"`
		CreatedAt          time.Time       `json:"created_at"`
		ExpiresAt          time.Time       `json:"expires_at"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&envelope); err != nil || envelope.TemplateCode != templateCode ||
		envelope.ResponseSchemaCode != templateCode || envelope.IdempotencyKey != idempotencyKey ||
		envelope.LanguageCode != strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Language)) || envelope.TemplateVersion < 1 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(envelope.ProviderCode) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(envelope.ProviderModel) == "" ||
		envelope.CreatedAt.IsZero() || !envelope.ExpiresAt.After(envelope.CreatedAt) {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(envelope.ExecutionID); err != nil {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var result domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent
	decoder = json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(envelope.ParsedResponse))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}

var _ domainservice.ContentGenerator = Client{}
